Exposed.description: Names in the global object a module is assigned to.

items.description: A name in the global object a module is assigned to.

ExposedItem.description: A name in the global object a module is assigned to.

ExposedItemObject.description: A name in the global object a module is assigned to.

globalName.description: The name in the global object, a nested name is created when it contains dots or is an array.

items.description: A part of the name in the global object.

moduleLocalName.description: The name of the export of the module to expose, the whole module is exposed when unset.

override.description: Overwrite an existing value in the global object.

ExposedItemShorthand.description: A name in the global object, optionally followed by the name of the export to expose and whether to overwrite an existing value, separated by a space or '|' (i.e. '_.map|mapExpose|true').

exposes.description: Modules to expose to the global object, keyed by the request of the module, as written in the source code or as an absolute path.

additionalProperties.description: Names in the global object the module is assigned to.

globalObject.description: An expression to the global object, defaults to the global object of the target environment.
